description: Simplified recreation of investing.com's linked real-time stock charts (https://www.investing.com/charts/real-time-stocks-charts), showing NVIDIA and Apple daily closing prices for 2025. The two line charts share pan/zoom: dragging on either chart pans both identically. Written directly in Vega (not Vega-Lite) so the tracked signal (pan_zoom) is backed by a real signal value rather than Vega-Lite's internal `_store` datasets, which reVISit's replay mechanism cannot repopulate. revisitAnswer rides on the existing pan interaction (responseId "line-trend-interacted", with no matching "response" entry in config.json). The NVIDIA chart's x-axis is a duplicate of the AAPL chart's real x_time axis (repositioned via encode.axis.update.y) so both charts always show identical ticks.
